subject: Initial evaluation playbook + timeline proposal
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Patel <sophie.patel@solstice.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial evaluation playbook + timeline proposal

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation I wanted to share an initial evaluation playbook and proposed timeline so we can align expectations and stakeholders up front. I attached a short MAP (redwood_initial_map_v1.pdf) with suggested milestones; high-level proposal below: 

- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff call, confirm success criteria and stakeholders
- Weeks 1–2: Environment access, sample dataset ingest, and smoke tests (security & connectivity)
- Weeks 3–4: Model evaluation against your prompts; latency/cost profiling and a small POC integration
- Week 5: Joint review + decision point (go/no-go or expansion)

Primary goals I heard from you: improve end-user latency for search re-ranking, reduce per-request cost vs current solution, and validate private deployment options for regulated workloads. Please confirm or correct those.

To make the MAP concrete, can you confirm: 
- Champion and decision owner at Solstice (name + email)
- Engineering stakeholders and a technical reviewer for infra/security
- Any legal/ procurement timelines we should lock against

Proposed kickoff: Wed Jul 9, 11:00 AM PT — if that works I can send a calendar invite and a short agenda (30m).

Attachments: redwood_initial_map_v1.pdf (draft MAP, milestones & mutual responsibilities)

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0123

Redwood Inference | developer-first inference for production-grade LLMs

Hi Aditya — thanks for putting this together. This is close to what I had in mind. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Champion / decision owner: Sophie Patel (me) — I’ll be the day-to-day champion and Jared Klein (jared.k@solstice.ai), VP Engineering, will be the executive decision owner.
2) Technical reviewers: Priya Menon (priya.m@solstice.ai), Data Platform Lead, and Diego (diego@solstice.ai) from infra.
3) Security: I’m attaching our evaluation security questionnaire so your security team can start reviewing (Solstice_Eval_Security_Questions.xlsx).

Kickoff: Wed Jul 9 at 11:00 AM PT works for our team — please send an invite. 

Success criteria to add:
- Achieve P50 latency under 120ms for inference on our production sample workload
- Demonstrate <30% lower per-request cost compared to our current provider for 99th percentile traffic profile
- Validate a private deployment option that meets our data residency requirements for EU/US 

Looking forward to the call.

— Sophie
Sophie Patel
Product & AI Lead | Solstice AI
sophie.patel@solstice.ai

Thanks Sophie — great clarity, this helps a lot. I’ve booked the kickoff for Wed Jul 9, 11:00 AM PT and sent a calendar invite (30 min). Calendar details: https://meet.google.com/mtg-redwood-solstice

Quick mutual-action items before kickoff (we can cover these in the 30m):
- You: Share list of sample prompts & a 1–2 GB representative sample of production traffic (S3 link or secure upload)
- Solstice infra: Provide network allowlist IPs or a test VM for smoke connectivity testing
- Redwood: Security contact (Monica) to start an initial pass on your questionnaire; I’ll share a short runbook and the draft MAP in Google Drive before the call
- Redwood: I’ll provision a small dedicated test seat and run baseline latency/cost profiling during Weeks 1–2

I’ve opened the deal in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/RW-2025-1593 — I’ll keep the MAP and artifacts linked there. Monica — can you take point on the security questionnaire? If you’re good, I’ll ask for any high-level gaps before the kickoff so the first call is focused on access and success criteria.

Sophie — appreciate you lining up Jared and Priya; please add any other folks to the invite. See you tomorrow.

Best,
